name: trustguard
description: AI firewall for Claude Code via lifecycle hooks, plus TrustGate MCP Gateway. For organizations that cannot use Anthropic Inference Hooks (Enterprise org hook).

trustguard_data_url.title: TrustGuard data URL
trustguard_data_url.description: TrustGuard data-plane base URL (serves /v1/evaluate), e.g. https://data.example.neuraltrust.ai. No trailing /v1/evaluate.

trustguard_api_key.title: TrustGuard collector API key
trustguard_api_key.description: Collector API key (tgk_…). Create a Claude Code / IDE collector in TrustGuard. Not an Inference Hook secret (whsec_…) and not a TrustGate MCP key.

trustguard_fail_mode.title: Fail mode
trustguard_fail_mode.description: When TrustGuard is unreachable: open (allow) or closed (deny). Default open.

trustgate_mcp_url.title: TrustGate MCP URL
trustgate_mcp_url.description: Optional. Full MCP endpoint from the TrustGate Connect tab, e.g. https://{host}/{consumer-slug}/mcp. Leave empty to skip the MCP Gateway.

trustgate_mcp_api_key.title: TrustGate MCP API key
trustgate_mcp_api_key.description: Optional. Consumer API key for X-AG-API-Key. Leave empty for OAuth consumers. Not the TrustGuard tgk_… key.

trustgate_gateway_slug.title: TrustGate gateway slug
trustgate_gateway_slug.description: Optional. X-AG-Gateway-Slug for hybrid / private data planes. Leave empty on SaaS when the host already identifies the gateway.
